mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 38 degrees that feels like 28. Also, keep in mind the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the Plan Commission has a meeting scheduled for December 7 to review various development projects, while the Municipal Court reminds residents that they can pay many traffic citations online or by phone without needing to make a court appearance.

There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, live music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company and Paddy Mac's, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market happening tomorrow as well.

Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for a first offence O W I after discovering him unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to grab a scoop.
